statement: Sharp one-third stability of Brenier maps. For uniform source measure ρ on a compact convex body with interior in dimension at least two, quadratic optimal transport maps satisfy $`\|T_\mu-T_\nu\|_{L^2(\rho)}\le C W_2(\mu,\nu)^{1/3}`$ uniformly over targets in a fixed compact set. The exponent is sharp, even for three-atom targets, disproving Letrouit's conjectured square-root bound.
